**Commentary of al-Jaza'iri (Aysar al-Tafasir) on Surah 6, verses 158–160:**

**Explanation of the words:**

*Ba'd ayat Rabbika* (some of the signs of your Lord): i.e., among the signs of the Hour is the rising of the sun from its place of setting.

*Kasabat fi imanha khayran* (earned good through her faith): through acts of obedience and drawing near to God.

*Farraqu dinahum* (they divided their religion): they made it into paths and sects opposing one another.

*Wa kanu shiya'an* (and became sects): groups and factions.

*Man ja'a bil-hasanah* (whoever comes with a good deed): i.e., whoever comes on the Day of Resurrection with the good deed, which is faith in God, affirming His oneness, and acting in obedience to Him and to His Messenger.

*Wa man ja'a bil-sayyi'ah* (and whoever comes with an evil deed): i.e., with associating partners with God and with His acts of disobedience.

**The meaning of the verses:**

After the mention of the proofs and the sending down of the signs, which are the greatest evidence for the soundness of monotheism and the falsity of polytheism, and while those who equate others with their Lord, the idols, remained in their hostile stance towards the truth, its call, and its Messenger, God the Exalted revealed His words: ﴿Do they await...﴾, i.e., what are they waiting for? ﴿...except that the angels should come to them﴾ to seize their souls, ﴿or your Lord should come﴾ on the Day of Resurrection to judge decisively, ﴿or some of the signs of your Lord should come﴾ indicating the nearness of the Hour, such as the rising of the sun from its place of setting. The stance of persisting in denial is the stance of one who awaits what God the Exalted has mentioned: the angels, the coming of the Lord the Exalted, or the coming of the signs of the Hour for annihilation. His words the Exalted: ﴿On the day when some of the signs of your Lord come﴾, indicating the nearness of the Hour, which is the rising of the sun from its place of setting, as a announcement of the nearness of the hour of annihilation in this state, God the Exalted informs that a soul which had not believed before the appearance of this sign, if it believes after its appearance, its faith will not be accepted from it nor will it benefit it, because it has become forced faith, not chosen faith. Likewise, a soul which believed before the sign but did not earn good in its faith, and wanted to earn good, that will not benefit it and it will not be rewarded for it, because the door of repentance remains open until this day, which is the day of the rising of the sun from its place of setting, for then it will be closed.

His words the Exalted: ﴿Say: Wait, indeed we are waiting﴾. God commands His Messenger to say to those who equate others with their Lord, persisting in polytheism and denial: as long as you are waiting, wait; indeed we are waiting for the hour of your destruction, for it is coming without doubt.

This is what the first verse [158] contains. As for the two verses after it, God the Exalted informed His Messenger that those who divided their religion and became sects, i.e., factions, parties and differing groups, like the Jews and the Christians, and whoever from this nation innovates innovations and is followed in them, they become differing sects, groups and schools, bitterly fighting and warring with one another. These ﴿you have no part in them at all﴾, i.e., you are free of them, and they are free of you. Their affair rests with God the Exalted, who will Himself requite them, for He will gather them on the Day of Resurrection, then inform them of what they used to do, of evil and good. ﴿Whoever comes with a good deed will have ten times its like, and whoever comes with an evil deed will be recompensed only with its like, and they will not be wronged﴾ from us, so We do not diminish the good-doer among them of any of his good deeds, nor add to his evil deeds an evil he did not commit. This is God's judgment concerning them.

**Guidance from the verses:**

1. Affirmation of the attribute of coming for the Lord, blessed and exalted, in the place of gathering on the Day of Resurrection, for the decisive judgment.

2. Establishment of the signs of the Hour, and that the rising of the sun is among them, and that when it appears the door of repentance is closed.

3. The prohibition of division in religion; the Jews and Christians divided their religion, and the nation of Islam has been afflicted with division likewise, indeed more so, based on the hadith: "This nation will split into seventy-three sects."

4. The freedom of the Messenger ﷺ from those who divided their religion, leaving the matter to God to judge between them with the wisdom of the just.

5. The multiplication of good deeds and the non-multiplication of evil deeds is justice and mercy from God.

After the mention of the proofs and the sending down of the signs, which are the greatest evidence for the soundness of monotheism and the falsity of polytheism, and while those who equate others with their Lord, the idols, remained in their hostile stance towards the truth, its call, and its Messenger, God the Exalted revealed His words: ﴿Do they await...﴾, i.e., what are they waiting for? ﴿...except that the angels should come to them﴾ to seize their souls, ﴿or your Lord should come﴾ on the Day of Resurrection to judge decisively, ﴿or some of the signs of your Lord should come﴾ indicating the nearness of the Hour, such as the rising of the sun from its place of setting. The stance of persisting in denial is the stance of one who awaits what God the Exalted has mentioned: the angels, the coming of the Lord the Exalted, or the coming of the signs of the Hour for annihilation. His words the Exalted: ﴿On the day when some of the signs of your Lord come﴾, indicating the nearness of the Hour, which is the rising of the sun from its place of setting, as a announcement of the nearness of the hour of annihilation in this state, God the Exalted informs that a soul which had not believed before the appearance of this sign, if it believes after its appearance, its faith will not be accepted from it nor will it benefit it, because it has become forced faith, not chosen faith. Likewise, a soul which believed before the sign but did not earn good in its faith, and wanted to earn good, that will not benefit it and it will not be rewarded for it, because the door of repentance remains open until this day, which is the day of the rising of the sun from its place of setting, for then it will be closed.

His words the Exalted: ﴿Say: Wait, indeed we are waiting﴾. God commands His Messenger to say to those who equate others with their Lord, persisting in polytheism and denial: as long as you are waiting, wait; indeed we are waiting for the hour of your destruction, for it is coming without doubt.

This is what the first verse [158] contains. As for the two verses after it, God the Exalted informed His Messenger that those who divided their religion and became sects, i.e., factions, parties and differing groups, like the Jews and the Christians, and whoever from this nation innovates innovations and is followed in them, they become differing sects, groups and schools, bitterly fighting and warring with one another. These ﴿you have no part in them at all﴾, i.e., you are free of them, and they are free of you. Their affair rests with God the Exalted, who will Himself requite them, for He will gather them on the Day of Resurrection, then inform them of what they used to do, of evil and good. ﴿Whoever comes with a good deed will have ten times its like, and whoever comes with an evil deed will be recompensed only with its like, and they will not be wronged﴾ from us, so We do not diminish the good-doer among them of any of his good deeds, nor add to his evil deeds an evil he did not commit. This is God's judgment concerning them.

**Guidance from the verses:**

1. Affirmation of the attribute of coming for the Lord, blessed and exalted, in the place of gathering on the Day of Resurrection, for the decisive judgment.

2. Establishment of the signs of the Hour, and that the rising of the sun is among them, and that when it appears the door of repentance is closed.

3. The prohibition of division in religion; the Jews and Christians divided their religion, and the nation of Islam has been afflicted with division likewise, indeed more so, based on the hadith: "This nation will split into seventy-three sects."

4. The freedom of the Messenger ﷺ from those who divided their religion, leaving the matter to God to judge between them with the wisdom of the just.

5. The multiplication of good deeds and the non-multiplication of evil deeds is justice and mercy from God.

Commentary of al-Jaza'iri (Aysar al-Tafasir) on surah 6, verses 161–165:

Explanation of the words:

Qiyaman (قيماً): i.e., upright (مستقيماً).

Millata Ibrahim (ملة إبراهيم): i.e., the religion of Ibrahim (ﷺ... peace be upon him), which is Islam.

Hanifan (حنيفاً): inclining away from misguidance toward guidance.

Wa nusuki (ونسكي): my sacrifice, slaughtered seeking nearness to Allah, the Exalted.

Wa mahyaya (ومحياي): my life.

Abghi Rabban (أبغي رباً): I seek a lord, i.e., a god worthy of worship, whom I worship.

Wa la taziru wazira (ولا تزر وازرة): i.e., no burdened soul bears (the burden of) a sinful soul, i.e., a sinful one.

Wizra ukhra (وزر أخرى): i.e., the sin of another soul.

Khala'if al-ard (خلائف الأرض): i.e., some of you succeed others: one generation dies and another lives until the end of life.

Liyabluwakum fima ataakum (ليبلوكم فيما آتاكم): i.e., to test you in what He has given you of health and sickness, wealth and poverty, knowledge and ignorance.

Meaning of the verses:

These verses are the conclusion of this surah, whose verses number about one hundred and sixty-some, and which were all concerned with disputation with those who equate others with their Lord, and with clarifying the path of guidance for them, so that they may believe, single out Allah in worship, and submit. In these verses, Allah commanded His Messenger to declare his separation from those polytheists, so He said to him: ﴿Say: Indeed, my prayer and my sacrifice and my living and my dying are for Allah, Lord of the worlds﴾, i.e., what I slaughter seeking nearness to my Lord, ﴿my living﴾, i.e., what I do during my life, ﴿and my dying﴾, i.e., what I die upon of acts of obedience and righteousness, ﴿for Allah, Lord of the worlds﴾ alone, ﴿no partner has He. And that I have been commanded﴾, i.e., my Lord, glorified and exalted, commanded me, ﴿and I am the first of the Muslims﴾, none will precede me ever. Likewise He commanded him to reject the polytheists' invitation to him ﷺ to worship their gods alongside them, so that they would worship his God alongside him. And He said: ﴿Say: Shall I seek other than Allah as a lord?﴾, i.e., shall I seek a god? ﴿While He is the Lord of all things﴾, i.e., there is no being in this life except that Allah is its lord, i.e., its creator, provider, and guardian, and its knower. No soul earns good except that it is for it, and it earns evil only against itself. And that ﴿no burdened soul bears the burden of another﴾, i.e., no sinful soul bears the sin of another sinful soul, and that the return of all is to Allah, the Exalted, ﴿Then to your Lord is your return, and He will inform you about that over which you used to differ﴾, i.e., He will judge between you, so whoever is saved is saved and whoever is destroyed is destroyed. As He told him to say: ﴿And it is He who made you successors upon the earth﴾, i.e., some of you succeed others: this one dies and bequeaths, and this heir dies and bequeaths. His saying ﴿and raised some of you above others in degrees﴾ means: this one is rich and this one is poor, this one is healthy and this one is blind, this one is knowledgeable and that one is ignorant. Then Allah, the Exalted, gave the reason for His arrangement concerning us by His saying ﴿to test you in what He has given you﴾, i.e., to test you in what He has given you, so that He may see the grateful and see the disbelieving. Trial necessarily entails success or failure, so He said: ﴿Indeed, your Lord is swift in punishment, and indeed He is Forgiving and Merciful﴾, so He punishes the disbeliever, and forgives and shows mercy to the grateful.

Guidance of the verses:

From the guidance of these verses:

1- The religion of Ibrahim (peace be upon him), which is Islam.

2- The legislation of saying ﴿Indeed, my prayer and my sacrifice and my living and my dying are for Allah, Lord of the worlds﴾ at standing for prayer.

3- It is not valid to seek a lord other than Allah, the Exalted, since He is the Lord of all things.

4- The justice of Allah, the Exalted, becomes manifest on the Day of Resurrection.

5- The justice of recompense on the Day of Resurrection.

6- The variation among people in wealth and poverty, health and sickness, righteousness and wickedness; and in everything there is a manifestation of Allah's arrangement in His creation, from which those who remember benefit, excluding those of heedlessness and forgetfulness.
